text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
(Being sent off by Trainer, and dashing 
forward.)

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
(To the turf where rivals await. Leaping 
onto the stage of a GⅠ race.)

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
(Even mid-race, it echoes astonishingly 
far— Helios's laughter. ...It overlaps 
with...)

text_block_list.name: Miracle's Father
text_block_list.text:
"Over here~! I'm waiting! Think you can 
run all the way over?"

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
(...Right. That's how it's been, in truth, 
all along.)

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
(It was fun. That's how I felt. And that's 
why... I was able to push even harder.)

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
(Because it's fun. It makes me think... I 
can keep trying even harder.)

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
I know I can get faster. ...It's all 
thanks to you.

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Ehh, I dunno what's going on!! Is this 
like a "let's do this!" declaration?! 
Like, like that!?!?

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Then I'm not gonna lose either~~~!! I'll 
have way more fun and get way faster, just 
you wait!!

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha! ...Yeah. Let's race again sometime, 
Helios!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
"Yo... Honestly, lately I've been 
wondering what I should do from here on 
out!"

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
I kind of thought getting my revenge on 
Miracle might be a good stopping point, 
but...

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Everything got completely blown away! It's 
all because of those two, and all thanks 
to those two!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Running and competing really is the best 
fun ever, suuuu!!

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
...I believe that is a very astute 
observation.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Holding those precious feelings close to 
her heart, K.S.Miracle now heads toward 
the grand stage of battle—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
We head to the festival that crowns the 
Spring Sprint King: the Takamatsunomiya 
Kinen.
